semiconductor_relevance: High — Viscom AG specializes in high-precision inspection solutions critical for quality control in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Viscom AG is a leading provider of advanced inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-end X-ray and optical inspection systems. Their technologies enable reliable quality control for ultra-fine structures in advanced packaging, ensuring high levels of quality and efficiency in production.
